responsibilities: Model the Data: Design, build and maintain scalable analytics data models in dbt, following analytics engineering best practices.
Own Data Quality: Build reliable transformations from raw product data to business-ready datasets, with testing, validation and documentation across the analytics layer.
Define the Metrics: Define, document and maintain the trusted business metrics used across the company, and keep definitions aligned across teams.
Build the Semantic Layer: Evolve a scalable semantic layer that makes consistent reporting and self-service analytics possible.

Power Experimentation: Partner with Product and Growth Managers on A/B tests, funnels, retention and customer insights, through high-quality event modelling and instrumentation. Then help teams read the results and decide what to do next.
Measure What Matters: Give product launches and feature rollouts reliable measurement frameworks from day one.
Enable Self-Service: Build dashboards and reports in Power BI, Hex or our internal AI tools, and coach stakeholders so they can find their own answers.
Lead with AI: Build AI-enabled analytics workflows and help teams across Doodle adopt AI in how they work with data.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build reliable transformations from raw product data to business-ready datasets, with testing, validation and documentation across the analytics layer.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Trusted data, testing, validation, documentation and "getting the numbers right" dominate; "move faster" appears once for AI tooling, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Every product decision, experiment, customer insight and business metric depends on it.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A B2B scheduling SaaS whose metrics drive product and business decisions with no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Product; Engineering; Sales; Marketing; Finance; Growth
evidence.data_team_maturity: co-own a share of the analytics layer that powers decisions across Doodle
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing dbt-on-Redshift stack and shared ownership of the analytics layer, with no sub-teams described, reads as mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Strong, hands-on experience building analytics data models with dbt or a similar transformation framework
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The stack and the work are named precisely (dbt on Redshift with Athena, Power BI, Hex, A/B tests, event modelling), so a reader can picture the work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with Product and Growth Managers on A/B tests, funnels, retention and customer insights
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Experimentation, product analytics and funnels with Product and Growth Managers carry the weight, so product.
evidence.autonomy_level: co-own a share of the analytics layer that powers decisions across Doodle
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Defining company metrics and a semantic layer is strategic, but it is co-ownership beside build-and-maintain delivery, so mixed.
evidence.ai_role: Build AI-enabled analytics workflows and help teams across Doodle adopt AI in how they work with data.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate both uses AI coding tools and builds AI-enabled workflows and a semantic layer for others to use; with both signals the tie-breaker gives ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: Build reliable transformations from raw product data to business-ready datasets, with testing, validation and documentation across the analytics layer.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: "Own Data Quality" is a named responsibility covering testing, validation and documentation.

evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trusted numbers are repeated as the product's value, but there is no compliance or incident language, so moderate.

evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Design, build and maintain with a semantic layer to evolve is mixed.
